_readme: jpn_for_eng lexical candidates (#447 jpn slice, 17 Nov). Target script is spaceless: these are substring regexes, not token checks. kp = a pre-fix or still-live text the regex must match (detect.cjs exits 3 otherwise). A hit is a candidate to READ.

jpn.re: [一-龯ァ-ヴー]ことがある|ますかから|[一-龯ァ-ヴー]があるから[。]?$
jpn.src: #195 follow-up d/6be32406: June generator glued ことがある/から onto seeds 301-668 targets (S0639L01B02); KNOWN family, basket rebuild

jpn.kp: ありがとう。でも、まだ学ぶことがある

jpn.re: ^(彼|彼女|彼ら|父|母|兄|姉|弟|妹|息子|娘|友だち|みんな)は[^？?]*(たい|たくない)[。]?$
jpn.src: #421 held 428 'たい is only you or I' (d/71221f73); live S0016L03U01. Bare -tai with a stated third-person subject needs -tagaru or an evidential (Makino & Tsutsui, Dictionary of Basic Japanese Grammar, -tai)

jpn.kp: 昨夜会ってほしかった
jpn.src: #447 jpn: S0151L02 'I was hoping = ほしかった' basket; ～てほしい = want SOMEONE ELSE to do (DBJG -te hoshii), so 'I was hoping to see you' rows say the wrong thing

jpn.re: の(隣|下|上|前|後ろ|近く|中)にある[。]?$
jpn.src: #434 held 467/487 (d/af659c82): '…にある' rows whose English lacks 'it's'

jpn.re: ^(ね|よ|から|だけ|ほど|のか|のが|ことが|ばかり|だろう|らしい|たかった|たくない|たくなかった|ほしかった|てほしい|なかった|なくても|ほうが)$
jpn.src: canon L7 (particle never an atomic LEGO) + L22 (bound element grows to the verb in its own seed); live S0120L01 'right = ね'

known:eng.src: #447 jpn: S0282L01 'no = うん' basket (うん is yes)
